bio: The inviting exterior of this 17C half-timbered house gives a taste of the traditional dining rooms inside, which are lovingly decorated with high-quality furnishings. It is the garden terrace, however, that is the real highlight! In the evening, you can order an ambitious set menu, the appealing vegetarian alternative, or regional classics and modern dishes à la carte. More limited options at lunchtime. Decent wine list. Contemporary-style guestrooms....
